messages:
Jonas: quick async — end-of-day checkin. SLOs mostly green but saw a small 10m spike in inference-99 around 02:14 UTC, likely from bursty batcher backlog. I pushed a temporary alert debounce for that rule.
Priya: ack — thanks for the debounce. do you have the grafana panel link so I can add to the postmortem? :mag_right:
Jonas: https://grafana.redwood/example/d/abc123/inference-latency (panel: inference-99) — spike aligns with a dozen 504s from batcher queue.
Tara: FYI leaving notes in the runbook under "batcher backpressure" with the exact timestamps and the debounce window I suggest. also pinged @Kevin for followup on batching config.
Kevin: saw the ping, will re-run the load replay tomorrow morning against canary and test the `max_batch_size` tweak. cc: @Priya if you can help validate the failure mode with the synthetic harness.
Priya: I can validate at 09:00 PT. what's the exact replay command?
Jonas: use this: ```./tools/replay_load.sh --workload inference --since 2026-03-16T02:00Z --duration 00:20:00 --rate 120``` — it reproduces the backlog locally against canary VM.
SRE-Bot: Alert summary: 1 active alert (inference-99 latency) muted by debounce policy at 02:18 UTC; 13 events in 10m window. Full log: https://logs.redwood/example/xyz
Tara: handoff note: oncall tomorrow is @Kevin AM -> @Jonas PM. If the replay shows persistent >800ms p99 unblock, open a P1 and we escalate.
Jonas: blockers for me: need review on the debounce roll (PR #4321) — tiny config change. @Priya or @Kevin can you LGTM before I merge?
Priya: will review in 30m.
Kevin: quick question on the PR — are we setting the debounce globally or per-rule? iirc we prefer per-rule so other noisy alerts aren't affected.
Jonas: per-rule, added comment in PR. also added a short note in runbook about temporary debounces and required followup (remove after root cause).
Priya: reviewed, left one nit about docs string. lgtm after fix.
Tara: thanks team — leaving a checklist in the runbook for tomorrow: reproduce -> tune max_batch_size -> monitor 24h -> remove debounce. ping me if anything spikes overnight. :white_check_mark:
Jonas: done, thanks. merging once CI passes. good winddown everyone.
